program.name: Field Strength Long
program.subject: Court & field sports
program.blurb: Long sessions of jumps then lifts: lower-body strength one day, upper the next.
program.about: Strength for contact and speed, with time for it. Each day opens with power jumps, then lifts in straight sets: squats, hinges and lunges one day, presses, rows and carries the next. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Power & lower lifts / power & upper lifts, long
